title: Metronome for Corgi
statementMd:
Azora the corgi loves music but cannot catch the rhythm well, especially when counting beats! After hard research on music theory, Azora found a hidden theorem: There won't be a note crossing the boundary between the beats for modern songs (or for most barking sessions for that matter).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb1367b0b15c438a5a44b27ac1a4c1b8c75792da.png)

To simplify the problem, we assume that a modern song consists of several sequential notes whose lengths are $l_1,l_2,\cdots,l_n$ milliseconds. The notes will be played one by one, which means the song will start playing the first note at time $0$, and the second note at the beginning of the $l_1+1$ milliseconds, and the third note at the beginning of the $l_1+l_2+1$ milliseconds, and so on.

If the length of the beat is $L$ milliseconds, then there should not exist any note that is playing but not starting to play at the beginning of the $kL$ milliseconds, for any non-negative integer $k$. Formally, there should not exist any note $i$ such that $\sum_{j=1}^{i-1} l_j \lt kL$ but $\sum_{j=1}^il_j \gt kL$ for any non-negative integer $k$.

Now Azora has received a new song from her humans, and she wants to practice counting beats before she barks the song back to them. To challenge herself, Azora wants to find the smallest possible length of a beat, such that it satisfies the theorem. Can you help her?

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $n~(1\le n\le 2\times 10^5)$, representing the number of notes in the song.

The second line contains $n$ integers $l_1,l_2,\cdots,l_n~(1\le l_i\le 10^9)$, representing the length of each note.

## Output

Output a single integer, representing the minimum possible length of a beat.
statementZhMd:
柯基 Azora 热爱音乐，却总是掌握不好节奏，尤其不擅长数拍子！经过对乐理的刻苦研究，Azora 发现了一条隐藏的定理：现代歌曲中的音符不会跨越节拍之间的分界（其实，大多数汪汪叫的时候也是如此）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb1367b0b15c438a5a44b27ac1a4c1b8c75792da.png)

为简化问题，我们假设一首现代歌曲由若干个依次排列的音符组成，它们的时长分别为 $l_1,l_2,\cdots,l_n$ 毫秒。这些音符将依次播放，也就是说，歌曲会在时刻 $0$ 开始播放第一个音符，在第 $l_1+1$ 毫秒开始时播放第二个音符，在第 $l_1+l_2+1$ 毫秒开始时播放第三个音符，依此类推。

如果每拍的时长为 $L$ 毫秒，那么对于任意非负整数 $k$，在第 $kL$ 毫秒开始时，都不应存在一个正在播放、却不是恰好在此时开始播放的音符。形式化地说，对于任意非负整数 $k$，都不应存在音符 $i$，使得 $\sum_{j=1}^{i-1} l_j \lt kL$ 且 $\sum_{j=1}^il_j \gt kL$。

现在，Azora 从主人那里收到了一首新歌，她想先练习数拍子，再用汪汪声把这首歌唱给他们听。为了挑战自己，Azora 想找到满足上述定理的最短每拍时长。你能帮助她吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n~(1\le n\le 2\times 10^5)$，表示歌曲中的音符数量。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $l_1,l_2,\cdots,l_n~(1\le l_i\le 10^9)$，表示每个音符的时长。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示每拍时长的最小可能值。
